title: Stage-0 selection benchmark scenario
description: One selection scenario: a requirement description whose expert-labelled primary architecture pattern is known. The family is the PatternCategory of the primary label; the train/holdout split is category-disjoint.

domain.description: Target architecture domain fed to analyze() verbatim. Live retrieval is domain-keyed (the two legs index catalogue domain slugs), so this value decides the candidate pool: it MUST be one of the primary label's suitable_domains (loader-enforced), and SHOULD be shared with an acceptable sibling so the near miss competes.

family.description: PatternCategory of the primary label; the split is disjoint over this value.

category.description: PatternCategory enum (src/schemas/enums.py) — must equal the primary label's catalogue category.

description.description: Requirement text fed to the pipeline verbatim (analyze.requirements).

weights.description: Requirement weights the scripted Stage-B agent returns verbatim in offline mode (QUALITY_ATTRIBUTE_KEYS).

style.description: Optional pinned ArchitectureStyle; when absent the analyze phase selects it.

primary.description: Pattern name (pattern/<name>-architecture.json) the pipeline should rank first.

acceptable_primary.description: Near-miss label set (same PatternCategory); hit/recall/F1 are computed over it.
